needed.evidence: The footway width is under 1m, which would be classified as none in some definitions
needed.suggestion: Install a wider or physically separated footway on the left side at least 1 metre in width, to provide safe pedestrian access.

needed.evidence: Obstructions partly block the already narrow footway
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the left footway to create a fully usable and clear pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections are visible as trip hazards on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repair uneven sections on the right footway to eliminate tripping hazards.

needed.evidence: The marked pedestrian crossing is not easily visible or lacks driver attention
needed.suggestion: Install signalised crossing or high-visibility markings and signage to enhance the crossing quality and ensure drivers stop.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs visible at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Introduce kerb ramps at both ends of the crossing to help pedestrians with mobility issues navigate easily.
